name: Arabic coffee
description: Pale lightly-roasted coffee heavy with cardamom, poured from a dallah.

tcm.note: Read with coffee; the cardamom adds warmth.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna from the coffee; green cardamom's own virya is contested but doesn't offset it.

unani.note: Qahwa is garam-khushk in the Arab record; the cardamom is added expressly to temper it.

histamine.note: Read as coffee, roast and origin notwithstanding.

stimulant.note: Caffeine alone, lightly roasted and usually cardamom-spiced.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
